pages.title: Stir-Frying
pages.text: The baking tray has $(thing)four slots$(), so four portions can fry at once. It only works while sitting $(thing)directly on a lit gas cooking stove$() — a cold stove gives no heat.$(br2)Right-click the top of the tray with food to put it in; $(thing)sneak and right-click with an empty hand$() ejects the topmost portion first.$(br2)It uses the vanilla $(thing)campfire cooking$() recipes, so anything you can cook on a campfire you can stir-fry on the tray.

pages.title: Stir-Frying
pages.text: Right-click the tray while holding a $(thing)Spatula$(); each hit advances the frying progress, and $(thing)five hits$() finish the batch.$(br2)Every hit also rotates the items in the slots one place along, and the spatula loses 1 durability.$(br2)When it is done the results pop out and drop beside the tray.
